meta.description: PV-D28. Daily 09:00 Asia/Makassar: read-and-remind, never decide. clients.list (carries each client's owner_user_id / owner_name; the internal sentinel client is skipped) -> per client contracts.list + invoicePayments.list (via the hub, clientId in the path) -> collect (a) payment claims status=pending recorded >2 days ago, (b) contracts status=sent that the client signed and we have not (clientSigned && !providerSigned) sent >1 day ago, (c) contracts status=sent with clientSigned=false sent >7 days ago. ROUTING: (c) goes to THAT client's account owner (owner_user_id); a client with no owner sends its (c) to the configured recipients, and the digest says 'no account owner set' for it. (a) and (b) always go to the configured recipients (BILLING_NOTIFY_USER_IDS, comma list; falls back to NOTIFY_USER_ID, the ops lead). ONE in-app digest per distinct recipient, covering only that recipient's items (counts + client names, linking /clients/<id>/billing), delivered via the hub `notify` tool, which takes a single recipientId, so the notify node runs once per digest item. If none qualify the run stops silently; a refused read throws; items for the configured recipients with none configured throws (owner digests need no configured recipients). It never sends, countersigns, confirms or rejects (those stay human, or agent-behind-D14). Scoped identity wf:billing-chaser -> [clients.list, contracts.list, invoicePayments.list, notify]; the platform service account is a manager (reads contract/invoice/client, notify). Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, BILLING_NOTIFY_USER_IDS or NOTIFY_USER_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "clients.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "contracts.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, clientId: $json.clientId } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "invoicePayments.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, clientId: $json.clientId } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: "billing_chaser_digest", payload: $json.payload } } }) }}
